name: King of Phoenix
source: King of Phoenix is a comedic adult harem dating sim set in sunny Phoenix, Arizona. Play as Dan Miller, a British journalist who is forced to take a layover in Phoenix and meets a couple of very lovely ladies there. What treasures lie in wait for him in this city? Money? Friendship? Passion? Waifus?
translation: 《凤凰王》是一款以阳光明媚的亚利桑那州凤凰城为舞台的喜剧成人后宫恋爱模拟游戏。扮演英国记者丹·米勒，他被迫在凤凰城转机，并在那里遇见几位非常可爱的女士。这座城市里有什么宝藏在等待他？金钱？友谊？激情？还是美少女？
